text.jp:
今は姫に対し、どのような声を
掛けたものか、それがしにはわかりませぬ。
text.official_en: I do not know what to say to you, milady.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_バッカニア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
いや、わかっておりまする。
今のそれがしに、姫と口を利く資格はないと。
text.official_en:
No, that's not right. Rather, I know that I have lost
any right to speak to you at present.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_バッカニア
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
このうえは、己の働きでもって
姫の信頼を取り戻すよう、邁進いたす所存です。
text.official_en:
From here forward, I will exhaust every effort to
regain your trust.

text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
至高のアーク、カーラの弓と
それに至るための試練、か……
text.official_en:
Kalla's Bow—a Supreme Arc that you must earn
by passing a test.
text.real_en:
Cara's Bow—a Supreme Arc that you must earn
by passing a test.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シロッコ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
至高のアークに至る道、その戸口に立つ事さえ、
普通の人間には認められぬものだ。
text.official_en:
Ordinary mortals are usually not permitted to even
step upon the path toward such hallowed items.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シロッコ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
やはり、貴女は我が主より、
特別な寵愛を受ける身であるのだな。
text.official_en: Clearly you are the recipient of my lady's favor.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シロッコ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……おれには、主からそのような扱いを受ける、
貴女のことが少々うらやましく思える……
text.official_en:
I am slightly envious to know that you receive such
respect from her.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シロッコ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
あの……レダさん、
バッカニアさんのこと許してあげてね。
text.official_en: Hey, Leda? I think you should go easy on Buccar.
text.real_en: Hey, Leda-san? I think you should go easy on Buccaneer-san.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ムウ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
だって……だってボクも
あの人の気持ち、わかるんだもの。
text.official_en: I mean, I get where he's coming from.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ムウ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
ボクだけじゃないよ、オリンピアさんだって。
レダさんに幸せになってほしいだけなんだ。
text.official_en:
Not just me, either! Olympia feels the same way.
We all just want you to be happy.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ムウ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
シロッコさんは、まあ……
何を考えてるのか、よくわからないけど……
text.official_en:
As for Sirocco, well... I dunno. I can never really tell
what it is he wants.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_オリンピア

text.jp:
気が付いたらあなたに対して
借りばかり増えていきますのね。
text.official_en:
Much to my chagrin, I appear to have become more
and more in your debt.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_オリンピア
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
……さすがに面白くはありませんわ。
これでは、姉としての威厳が保てませんわ。
text.official_en:
It's not funny in the slightest. This is no way to
maintain my dignity as a big sister!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_オリンピア
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
……だれの姉ですって？
知れたこと。あなたの姉ですわ。
text.official_en: "Whose big sister?" Why, yours, of course!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_オリンピア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
以前にも言っておりましたでしょう、
あたくしのことを「お姉さま」と呼ばせてみせると。
text.official_en:
I told you before that, with time, I would have you
treat me as one!

text.jp:
そういえば其方の次の相手は
サラミス王国の女王であったな。
text.official_en:
Your next opponent is the queen of Saramis.
Isn't that right?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カーラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
父上であれば……あのような国、
決して認めることはなかっただろうな。
text.official_en:
If my father had had his way, that country would
never have been founded.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カーラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
………………
……いや、なんでもないのだ。
text.official_en: Ah, but forget I said anything.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カーラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
あの国の数奇なる成り立ちを
少し……思い返していただけだ。
text.official_en:
I was just reflecting on the kingdom's circuitous path
through history.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カーラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
父上の治世と兄上の治世、ともにダグザ帝国を
発展させているが、中身は対照的だ。
text.official_en:
My father and brother both expanded the empire,
in their differing ways.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カーラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
父上の支配は、いうなれば
恐怖と強制を下敷きとした発展。
text.official_en: Father, by wielding fear and coercion.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カーラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
一方で兄上の手法は、
協調と融和……とでも言おうか。
text.official_en:
And my brother, through cooperation and
reconciliation.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カーラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
どちらが正解なのかは、妾にはわからぬが……
後世の歴史家によって、記されるのだろう。
text.official_en:
Whose technique was the better? It's difficult to say,
but I'm sure future historians will have their verdicts.
